usages.explain: Used with question words like「だれ/なに/どれ/どこ/いつ」to express "whichever/whatever/wherever/whenever" situation. When used with affirmative sentences, it means "in all cases," and with negative sentences, it means "none at all."

examples.content: 彼女がだれであるかだれも知らない。
examples.transcription: かのじょがだれであるかだれもしらない。
examples.mean: No one knows who she is.

examples.content: 偶然に生じるものはなにもない。
examples.transcription: ぐうぜんにしょうじるものはなにもない。

title: Nghi vấn từ＋(trợ từ) + も => Also (affirmative),...both (negative)
